notes: The reported bug (22-PO shipment): new skill booked the minimum 3 containers and made no false impossibility claim in 4/4 runs; old skill 2/4. Small sample (Fisher exact p about 0.43), consistent with the fix, not proof of it.

Large shipments: container count did not move (1/2 vs 1/2 on each). Opus reached the known best (8) with either skill; Sonnet landed at 9 with either. Guidance fixes claims, not packing strength. Step 2 (ship a packer) is what should move this.
No overcorrection: on the oversize-PO shipment both skills flagged the impossible PO with its volume and asked before splitting (2/2 each).
Tolerance/slack reporting: new 8/8, old 5/8. The new skill's reports name spare cm per container or re-pack results at +1 to +3 mm.
Non-discriminating checks: 'every PO whole' and 'no container over capacity' pass in every run of both skills. Agents do not break hard constraints; they over-book.

Tokens +16% with the new skill. Time is not comparable: the 12 new runs ran concurrently while the 4 old 22-PO runs ran in an earlier smaller batch, and several runs idled on their own background searches.

Data caveat: the 4 old-skill 22-PO runs lost their plan.md files to an unexplained folder deletion. Their allocations were restored from committed anonymized copies, and the judge graded their final replies instead.
